title: Enhancing Gender-Inclusive Machine Translation with Neomorphemes and Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLMs on English-to-Italian machine translation of sentences with gender-ambiguous human referents using the NEO-GATE benchmark. The evaluation measures the models' ability to correctly generate and apply gender-inclusive neomorphemes (specifically the Asterisk and Schwa paradigms) instead of defaulting to binary gendered inflections, utilizing metrics such as coverage, accuracy, and mis-generation rates.
